rows.implementation: `Add ▸ GOO Engine` sub-menu (Shader / Textures / Compositor / Utility), `goo.add_node_group`

rows.feature: Shader Info — Diffuse Shading / Cast Shadows / Self Shadows / Ambient Lighting / Half-lambert factor
rows.implementation: `GOO Shader Info` (24 nodes): white Diffuse → `Shader to RGB` gives EEVEE luminance; `Cast Shadows=(1-AO_wide)·ShadowStrength`, `Self Shadows=(1-AO_narrow)` (off by default), `Ambient=AmbientColor·Strength·AO_wide`. GOO itself evaluates these **per light in C++** (`closure_eval_surface_lib.glsl`)
`Material.goo_check_self_shadowing` + `GOO Shader Info ▸ Check Self Shadowing` input; a metadata flag, it does not change the renderer

rows.feature: Light Groups — name-based groups on lights/materials, per-group shadow toggle, default group
rows.implementation: `Scene.goo_light_groups` + material/object links; each group owns a **detached** receiver collection assigned via native `Light.light_linking.receiver_collection`; `use_shadow` written with backup/restore; empty groups hide their lights; `goo render --light-groups` + `goo composite` reproduce the image linearly (1e-6 mean diff)

rows.feature: Shadow ID `High ID Bit Depth` (32-bit shadow IDs)
rows.implementation: `Scene.goo_high_bit_depth` / `Material.goo_check_self_shadowing` flags only; EEVEE Next has no shadow ID buffer
EEVEE Next has no contact-shadow controls

rows.feature: Shadow buffer bias / Cascaded Shadow Maps / light-cache bake UI
rows.implementation: Renderer internals of the `gooengine` fork

rows.feature: Set Depth — push a shader's pixel depth
rows.implementation: `GOO Set Depth` (16 nodes): Camera Data View Z + Mode/Scale/Offset/Near/Far → `Depth`, `View Z`, `Alpha`. It **encodes** depth for an EXR/AOV pass; no `gl_FragDepth` write

rows.feature: Light Info (legacy) — chosen light's Color/Power/Perceptual Power
rows.implementation: `GOO Light Info` (8 nodes) + `goo.light_info_from_active`: 5 drivers (`data.energy`, `data.color[i]`, `data.specular_factor`) update live, where GOO bakes uniforms at compile time

`GOO Light Info New` + `goo.light_info_new_from_active`: 11 drivers (color, energy, `location[i]`, `rotation_euler[i]`, camera-to-light distance expression). GOO's node declares the five outputs but its GPU function only feeds color/power; this port supplies all five
5.2 holdout is a whole-object mask; no alpha-blend holdout
GOO panel edits native `ViewLayer.material_override`, `world_override`, `samples`; `goo.clear_view_layer_overrides`; CLI `--view-layer NAME` selects one layer per render
5.2 exposes `ViewLayer.samples` (Cycles semantics); EEVEE uses `scene.eevee.taa_render_samples`; CLI takes `--samples`

rows.feature: Shift-click collection visibility to force-enable children

rows.feature: Radiance buffer copied between Refraction passes
rows.implementation: Renderer internal
C++ renderer; not exposed

rows.feature: Screen Space Info — Scene Color / Scene Depth
rows.implementation: `GOO Screen Space Info` (10 nodes, no inputs): Screen Position, Screen UV, View Depth, View Distance, World Position, Facing, Fresnel, Camera Vector. EEVEE Next does not expose scene buffers to shaders; use `goo render --passes depth`
`GOO Curvature` (17 nodes): narrow-minus-wide AO + Layer Weight Fresnel, `Radius/Samples/Contrast`. GOO uses screen-space curvature
Not exposed by 5.2
`GOO SDF Primitive` (8 representative shapes: sphere, box, rounded box, cylinder, torus, capsule, plane, cone), `Vector/Shape/Size/Radius/Roundness` inputs
`GOO SDF Op` (8: union/intersect/diff/smooth variants/onion/dilate)
`GOO SDF Vector Op` (8: repeat, rotate, mirror, polar, twist, bend, grid, swizzle)
`GOO SDF Noise` (fBM-based distance perturbation)

rows.feature: Hex Grid Texture — Cell UV + integer Cell ID
rows.implementation: `GOO Hex Grid` (true hex tiling; outputs `Value`, `Color`, `Hex Coords`, `Position`, `Cell UV`, `Cell ID` + `Mask`/`Cell` aliases)

rows.feature: Water Ripples — Drops / Ripples / Flow / Caustic
rows.implementation: `GOO Water Ripples` (single radial field: `Vector, Scale, Time, Wavelength, Decay, Center → Color, Height, Normal`); no mode switch
`GOO Twirl` (real 2D rotation around a center, radius falloff)
`GOO OKLab Color Ramp` (4 stops, exact OKLab matrix); GOO has a full ramp widget with arbitrary stops

rows.feature: Scene Time — Start Frame / End Frame
rows.implementation: `GOO Scene Time` (GeometryNodeTree): native Seconds/Frame plus Start/End Frame values refreshed from `scene.frame_start/frame_end` by `frame_change_pre`/`render_pre` handlers; verified in an evaluated GN modifier
Blender socket defaults reject `inf`

rows.feature: Active camera override — GN `Active Camera` uses `scene.gn_camera_override` when its new `Ignore Scene Override` input is off
rows.implementation: `GOO Active Camera` group: `Ignore Scene Override` + `Override Camera` (Object) → `Active Camera` (Object), implemented with the native Active Camera node and an OBJECT switch; plus CLI `goo render --camera NAME`. Native nodes created without the group still read `scene.camera` (no C++ injection)
Native in 5.2; all GOO GP tools are written against GP v3 data

rows.feature: Texture Mapping randomize — Stroke/Fill offset, scale, rotation, seed
rows.implementation: `goo.gp_random_texture` writes a per-stroke `goo_tg_random` (CURVE, FLOAT) attribute + seed; material reads it via `Attribute`
`goo.gp_smooth_strokes`: Laplacian smoothing of the current drawing (factor, iterations, selected-only, cyclic-aware, endpoints preserved); GOO blends it into the sculpt brush instead
`goo.gp_auto_close` sets the `cyclic` CURVE boolean on selected strokes; explicit, where GOO closes while drawing
`goo_viewport_linewidth_enabled` / `goo_viewport_line_width` + `gpu.state.line_width_set` draw handler; viewport only
Input/transform core is C++
`goo.pose_isolate_bones`: hides unselected bones and restores them on a second run (GOO keeps a view-layer flag that is active only during a modal move)

rows.feature: Hide pose bones / Outliner hidden-bones filter
rows.implementation: `PoseBone.hide_outliner` re-created on an ID property, set/cleared by `goo.pose_outliner_flag`, shown in the GOO Pose panel. Blender 5.2 has no Outliner row-filter hook; the GOO 4.4 public branch stores the flag and exposes the UI but has no consumer either, so the data model matches and only the row filter is unavailable
`goo.copy_rotation_invert_all` sets/clears the three per-axis invert booleans on selected bones' Copy Rotation constraints (GOO stores one `ROTLIKE_INVERT_ALL` bit)

`goo.pose_constraints_merge`: copies constraints from a source armature by bone name onto the selected bones of the active rig, re-linking `target`/`space_object`; GOO also walks selected bones across multiple objects
